name: meeting1_platform_sync
description: Platform team sync. Tests: jargon (Kubernetes, Helm, NGINX, Traefik, Grafana, PagerDuty, Terraform, PostgreSQL, Redis, p99), a rejected proposal, a deferred proposal, an unresolved proposal, a task with no owner, a request that is later accepted, numbers and negations.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Okay, let's get started. Three things today: the Kubernetes migration, the Grafana alerts, and the PostgreSQL upgrade.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: On the migration, we moved 14 of the 20 services to the new Kubernetes cluster last week. The remaining 6 are blocked on the Helm charts.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: What's blocking the Helm charts exactly?

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: The ingress config. Our NGINX annotations don't work with the new controller.

turns.speaker: Ankit
turns.text: I think we should switch to Traefik as the ingress controller. It handles that config natively.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: I don't think that's a good idea right now. Switching controllers mid-migration adds risk, and nobody on the team has run Traefik in production.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Agreed. Let's not switch controllers this quarter.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: Then I'll rewrite the annotations for the 6 remaining services by Thursday.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Great. Next, the Grafana alerts. We got paged 42 times last week and most of them were false positives.

turns.speaker: Ankit
turns.text: Most of them come from the p99 latency alert. The threshold is 300 milliseconds, which is too tight for the batch endpoints.

turns.speaker: Ankit
turns.text: I propose we raise the threshold to 500 milliseconds for the batch endpoints only.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: That sounds reasonable. Rahul, any objection?

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: No objection. Let's do it.

turns.speaker: Ankit
turns.text: Also, can we route the batch alerts to Slack instead of PagerDuty?

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: Yes, good idea, PagerDuty should only wake people up for real outages.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Okay, both decided. Someone needs to update the alert rules in Terraform.

turns.speaker: Ankit
turns.text: I can't take it this week, I'm out from Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Fine, we'll leave it unassigned for now, but it has to be done before the next on-call rotation.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Last item, the PostgreSQL upgrade from version 13 to 16.

turns.speaker: Ankit
turns.text: We should do it during the maintenance window on the 15th. The downtime should be under 10 minutes.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: Let's not fix the date yet. We haven't tested the upgrade on the staging replica.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Okay, let's revisit the date next week once staging is tested.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Ankit, can you run the upgrade on staging and share the results?

turns.speaker: Ankit
turns.text: Sure, I'll do that by Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: One more thing. Should we also move the Redis cache into the cluster?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Good question, but we're out of time. Thanks everyone, and thanks Rahul for taking the annotations.

decisions: Raise the p99 latency alert threshold to 500 milliseconds for the batch endpoints only
Route the batch alerts to Slack instead of PagerDuty
not_decisions: Switch the ingress controller to Traefik
Do the PostgreSQL upgrade in the maintenance window on the 15th
Move the Redis cache into the cluster

action_items.task: Rewrite the NGINX annotations for the 6 remaining services
Update the alert rules in Terraform
Run the PostgreSQL upgrade on staging and share the results
